reviewedRootCorrections.evidence: Flutterwave fetchTransfer normalizes status to uppercase then uses lowercased failed-set comparison. Independent synthetic tests recognize FAILED, failed, ReVeRsEd, CANCELLED and canceled. Root pre-classifier test failed exact FAILED retirement (20/21); revised classifier passes.

fetchTransfer rejects mismatched processor transfer id; scheduler validates NGN, transfer identity, available stored merchant reference and exact bounded integer amount before success/failure effects. Independent success contradictions and root failed contradictions preserve processing/paid_kobo0. Missing amount becomes zero but integerKobo rejects terminal effect; malformed/sub-kobo amounts fail provider parser.

Failure retirement requires statusprocessing, and success transaction locks payout and rechecks its amount/provider id/reference. Delayed FAILED cannot overwrite concurrently successful payout or add failed audit. Acceptance/timeout/missing identifier retains processing reservation.
